findings.claim: 0x14002F9F0 is a pure thunk to 0x140048E20; FileSlot+0x10 is selected-backend logical/materialized size authority at this path. Lower whole-file open permits size zero, while the packed/.lst representation selector requires rounded size > 0.

whole-file transfer is rounded to 0x800, but physical/ZIP STORE/raw-DEFLATE paths terminate or clamp at logical EOF; read==0 is normal terminal short completion, read<0 is error, and callback reports actual produced bytes
0x1402EF620 returns ceil(logicalSize/0x800)*0x800; direct/packed planning uses rounded capacity; canonical allocator zeroes full requested payload before materialization
full materialization payload is memset to zero before writer/materializer use, so unwritten .lst alignment gaps remain zero
.lst planner/writer use matching aligned header/child placement and rounded/recursive size sources; child queue/recursive return values are not universally aggregated into terminal parent success
0x1402EF4D0 enqueues a type-2 whole-file path-load job into a caller-owned destination buffer, normalizes path separators, advances lane producer and returns insertion success/failure
type-2 job persists while status==2; status==3 closes whole-file state, clears job and advances lane; FIFO-only completion model is rejected

status-4 local path does not mirror success retirement; 0x1402EF460 is pending queue rollback/truncation under LoadedResource cancellation policy. Exact owner that converts terminal transfer error into suppression of later normal state2 publication remains open
partial production composes as progress, zero production as normal terminal EOF, negative as failure for common physical/STORE/DEFLATE paths; exhaustive malformed/error breadth remains secondary
relative slot starts/parent spans do not establish a universal intrinsic serialized child EOF

0x1401B8CA0 true is not universal terminal-byte completion: nonzero descriptor direct path ignores 0x1402EF4D0 insertion result, packed selector path propagates it, and .lst path returns local structural/scheduling acceptance
helper polls to status 3 or 4, closes state, then returns rounded capacity without encoding status4 as distinct return; relevant to .lst descriptor-load error breadth

non_claims: 0x1401B8CA0 true means all async bytes are terminally complete
relative slot span is intrinsic child EOF
